Use asynchronous HTTP operations with Future return values. Server URL must be configurable for Android physical devices. Never use localhost as the default remote server address. POST /rides/{id}/cancel cancels a ride. Propagate HTTP errors to callers. Never open a SQLite database. Never implement server-side business transitions locally.","entity":"Ride","implements":"RideRepository","name":"HttpRideRepository","provider":"http"}

- Implement exactly the persistence component specified in this contract.
- Reuse domain entities and repository interfaces supplied as dependencies.
- Do not declare duplicate domain entities or repository abstractions.
- Do not invent delete or CRUD methods absent from the specified interface.
- When an interface is supplied, implement its signatures exactly; otherwise do not fabricate one.
- Use only the persistence provider specified in this contract.
- Do not invent package APIs, classes or unavailable imports.
- Output only Dart source code without markdown.

SEALED HTTP CONSTRUCTION API:
- Required public constructor: HttpRideRepository(String baseUrl)
- The baseUrl is provided by the application bootstrap.
- Use dart:io HttpClient for HTTP requests.
- Use Future<T> for every repository operation.
- Implement the supplied RideRepository interface exactly.
- Use the baseUrl for every request.
- Do not hardcode localhost or any server IP address.
- Do not open SQLite or create a local database.
- Convert JSON responses into Ride entities.
- Propagate HTTP and connection errors to callers.

{"depends_on":["application.RequestRide","application.ListAvailableRides","application.GetRideStatus","application.AcceptRide","application.StartRide","application.CompleteRide","application.CancelRide"],"description":"Single-root Flutter Android application with a dark navy and yellow TaxiCat visual identity.
Show the TaxiCat logo and two role choices: PASSENGER and DRIVER.
PASSENGER MODE: Use passenger ID 10 for demonstration. Display a prominent Request Ride button. After requesting, display ride ID and current status. Refresh ride status every two seconds while visible. Allow cancellation only for REQUESTED or ACCEPTED rides.
DRIVER MODE: Use driver ID 20 for demonstration. Show available REQUESTED rides from the backend. Refresh the list every two seconds while visible. Allow accepting an available ride. For the assigned ride show Start Ride when ACCEPTED and Complete Ride when IN_PROGRESS.
Both modes must communicate with the same HTTP backend. Show connection errors clearly. Show loading indicators during operations. Never fabricate ride records or backend connectivity. Dispose polling timers when no longer needed. Keep the user interface responsive. Use one root screen with internal role selection.

MAPBOX BACKGROUND:
Use mapbox_maps_flutter to render a real interactive MapWidget.
Use a Stack with the map as the bottom layer.
Keep passenger and driver controls visible above the map.
Initial camera: latitude 19.28, longitude -99.65, zoom 13.
Do not implement GPS tracking, routes or markers yet.
Do not initialize MapboxOptions in the screen.
The deterministic CIDD bootstrap initializes Mapbox.
Preserve all HTTP use cases, polling and ride transitions.
